description: A utility class for generating and sending various email templates related to customer actions and order status updates in an e-commerce system, including order confirmation, registration, contact inquiries, order status updates, download instructions, and password change notifications.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesUtils
classes.description: A Spring component providing asynchronous methods to generate and send various email notifications related to customer activities and order updates in an online shop.

methods.name: sendOrderEmail
methods.description: Send an order confirmation email to a customer after order completion, including billing/shipping addresses and order details.

methods.name: sendRegistrationEmail
methods.description: Send a welcome email to a customer upon registration, including account access details.

methods.name: sendContactEmail
methods.description: Send an email containing a contact form message to the store's email address.

methods.name: sendUpdateOrderStatusEmail
methods.description: Notify the customer about an update in their order status, including status message and comments.

methods.name: sendOrderDownloadEmail
methods.description: Send an email with instructions for downloading digital products associated with an order.

methods.name: changePasswordNotificationEmail
methods.description: Send a notification email to a customer after their password has been changed.
